name: Water Quality Classification Model – Lithuanian Lake Monitoring
description: Random Forest Classifier trained to predict water quality class (Good/Moderate/Poor) of Lithuanian lakes based on 11 physicochemical measurements. Trained on National Lakes Monitoring Data provided by Aplinkos apsaugos agentūra. Achieves 91.9% accuracy. Developed for TU Wien Data Stewardship course 194.045, 2026S.

trainingData.name: National Lakes Monitoring Data – Lithuania
trainingData.description: Physicochemical measurements of Lithuanian lakes including pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity, turbidity, and nutrient levels. Sourced from Aplinkos apsaugos agentūra via DBRepo.

evaluationMetrics.evaluationDataset: 20% stratified test split of training data

intendedUse: Predict water quality classification (Good/Moderate/Poor) for Lithuanian lakes based on physicochemical measurements. Intended for academic research and educational purposes as part of TU Wien Data Stewardship course 194.045.
outOfScopeUse: Not intended for production environmental monitoring, regulatory decisions, or application to lakes outside Lithuania without retraining. Not validated for real-time or streaming data.
limitations: Model trained exclusively on Lithuanian lake data; generalisation to other geographic regions is not guaranteed. Performance may degrade on lakes with physicochemical profiles outside the training distribution.
